title: Bridge wordmark
description: A plain wordmark: a line icon and a company name in the display face, with a small parent-company tagline set beside it on one line or tucked underneath.
notes: pass any lucide icon; it is sized to the name
name: bridge-wordmark

props.name: icon
props.description: a small icon before the name (e.g. a lucide icon)

props.name: tagline
props.description: the small line beside or under the name, e.g. "a Halden company"

props.name: layout
props.description: stacked: tagline under the name (phones, footer) · inline: beside it · responsive: stacked on phones, inline from lg
